answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable reputation bond before it can trade: the bond is staked on-chain, earned back slowly through honest work, and slashed when peers attest fraud. One fake identity costs little, but a thousand fakes must lock a thousand bonds, so the attacker cost grows like a river fed by every tributary while honest agents pay once. A Sybil farm then leaves only a relic of wasted stake stranded in the tundra of untrusted identities, because creating identities is free but making each one trusted is expensive.
